about: The record has a line for major depression (L001) and no antidepressant of any kind is supplied in the 10 months that follow; only background medicines are supplied.

Possible finding: Dothep (dosulepin) is supplied monthly and no non-tricyclic antidepressant is supplied. The missing fact is Major depression. The tricyclic supply alone does not establish a current episode.
The record has a line for major depression and Zoloft (sertraline) is supplied every month, so a non-tricyclic antidepressant is in place and there is no finding.
The GP and patient agreed on a clinically appropriate plan for the current episode using talking therapy alone.
Duloxetine was supplied only for neuropathic pain and a later GP note documents that the major depressive episode is untreated, so the current regimen needs review.
Possible finding: duloxetine was supplied only for neuropathic pain and the record does not establish whether that regimen also treats the current major depressive episode.
